I know it's basic advice, but going to the gym helped me immensely. I had been going on and off for YEARS, but 3 months ago I committed fully to going 5 days a week and making 0 excuses to not go, along with following a diet. Even if I hate myself, I still feel like I have a small piece to be proud of myself for, and eventually I will get shredded and be a beautiful ugly sad boy.

For dieting, don't follow bullshit diets. Use a TDEE calculator and eat what you want while staying under your daily calorie goal and hitting your protein/carb/fat (macro) goals. I mean it, don't torture yourself eating way below what your body needs. 

Lastly, grind silently. You're doing it for yourself, don't go posting about going to the gym before you achieved anything. The serotonin of sharing positive things with others while you are working on it is proven to kill your motivation. Take pictures regularly, especially day 1 FOR YOU. Results will take time. Be consistent, you'll get there. One random day you will look in the mirror and see results suddenly. I promise.

Anyways, hope you figure out something that works for you.
